description: Three views of the Telegraph network. operators: miners grouped by the fee address they pay out to, and per intent how many independent operators a buyer can actually choose from (two miners on one address are one opinion). disagreement: how often miners from different operators disagree per intent, from Takar's comparisons on EAS, with 95% Wilson intervals. signal: one Telegraph signal hash checked on the node, in Takar's paid ledger, and inside the EAS-anchored Merkle root of that ledger.
name: network_check
